facts.rationale: The current body directly traces controller records through snapshotting, polling, clamping, unavailable-channel recovery, valid-port selection, edge detection, repeat generation, and persistent outputs. Shows the caller consuming `xC0` after retrace-paced calls while recognizing successive controller-button masks.
